title: ??琴峡
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.48 m, eave 3.68 m, ridge 5.91 m above the ground
by the hall kit: 1 bay, steps on the back, front, 攒尖 pyramid, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons. No text or drawing names it in 日下旧闻考 j80-82, the Qianlong poems on Kanripo, 養吉齋叢錄, Malone 1934, the witnesses of 1860, what search indexes show of the Yangshi Lei drawings.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled ??琴峡 (? marks an unread character).
